title: 日本央行突袭债市：首席5.3%是过度反应？，干预难改利率轨迹
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: John Woods is here with us on sets, Asia, CIO, and head of investment solution at Longboard, ODA.
segments.zh: 约翰·伍兹来到我们节目，他是亚洲首席投资官，也是隆巴德·奥迪耶亚洲投资方案主管。

segments.en: You guys are neutral DM sovereign bonds. This has changed your mind at all over that call. What does this change if at all?
segments.zh: 你们对发达市场主权债券持中性立场。这一事件是否改变了你们的看法？如果有变化，是什么？

segments.en: Well, this is new news. This is something that we have to look at closely.
segments.zh: 这是新消息，我们需要密切关注。

segments.en: Is it a one-off? Is it part of a sustained series of interventions in the market?
segments.zh: 这是否是一次性事件？还是市场干预的持续系列行动的一部分？

segments.en: Obviously, this is a real yield in term premium story. And whether intervention impacts that or changes that is less certain.
segments.zh: 显然，这涉及实际收益率和期限溢价。干预是否影响或改变这一点，尚不确定。

segments.en: We, of course, had the US intervening in the end a couple of weeks ago that seemed to be more of a one-off than a sustained concerted program of intervention.
segments.zh: 几周前美国也进行了干预，但似乎更像是一次性行动，而非持续协调的干预计划。

segments.en: So I think the market and people like us, asset allocators, will be looking very closely at what this translate to. If it's a one-off, I don't think it has any major impact at all.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为市场和像我们这样的资产配置者将密切关注其影响。如果是一次性事件，我认为不会有重大影响。

segments.en: It's a fundamental story rather than an intervention story. Possibly that 5.3 was a knee-jerk reaction when the 30-year hit that level maybe that was seen as some sort of a reaction required.
segments.zh: 这是基本面故事，而非干预故事。5.3%的收益率可能是30年期触及该水平时的膝跳反应，或许被视为某种必要的反应。

segments.en: But my sense is that it's not going to change the meaningfully the trajectory if it's a one-off. But until we get to see more sense of how that term premium is going to be addressed.
segments.zh: 但我的感觉是，如果是一次性事件，它不会显著改变轨迹。但我们需要更清楚地看到期限溢价将如何被解决。

segments.en: So what do you think ultimately could bring rates lower? If it's not intervention like this, if it's a one-off,
segments.zh: 那么您认为最终什么能压低利率？如果不是这种干预，如果是一次性事件，
